title: SIMM/UMR Initial Margin Dispute Detection
architecture: LLM classifies dispute existence + attributes root cause; all SIMM-style margin aggregation generator-side.
methodology_note: SIMM-style margin methodology: real ISDA SIMM aggregation structure (risk-weighted sensitivities, correlation-aggregated within and across buckets, summed across risk classes), with AAL's own illustrative risk-weight and correlation constants -- NOT ISDA's licensed SIMM calibration. See d007_common.py docstring.
